**Nevado Tres Cruces** is a massif of volcanic origin in the [Andes Mountains](Andes "Andes") on the border of <Argentina> and <Chile>. It has two main summits, Tres Cruces Sur at 6,748 metres (22,139 ft) and Tres Cruces Centro at 6,629 m (21,749 ft) and a third minor summit, Tres Cruces Norte 6,030 m (19,780 ft). Tres Cruces Sur is the sixth highest mountain in the Andes.

The volcano has an extended history of activity, going back at least 1.5 million years. A number of [lava domes](Lava_dome "Lava dome") surround the complex and a number of craters lie on its summits. The main volcano is of [rhyodacitic](Rhyodacitic "Rhyodacitic") composition and has generated two major [ignimbritic](Ignimbrite "Ignimbrite") eruptions, one 1.5 million years ago and a second 67,000 years ago. The last eruption was 28,000 years ago, but the volcano is a candidate source for a <Holocene> eruption and could erupt again in the future.
